description: This file defines classes and traits related to logging events within a Spark pipeline, including event details, origin, severity levels, and the main PipelineEvent class with message handling.

classes.name: PipelineEvent
classes.description: Represents an internal event during a pipeline run, including details like id, timestamp, origin, level, message, details, and optional error.

classes.name: PipelineEventOrigin
classes.description: Describes the origin of an event, including dataset name, flow name, and source code location.

classes.name: FlowProgress
classes.description: Event detail indicating a flow has transitioned to a new status.

classes.name: RunProgress
classes.description: Event detail indicating a run has transitioned to a new state.

classes.name: EventLevel
classes.description: Sealed trait representing severity levels of events (INFO, WARN, ERROR).

methods.name: messageWithError
methods.description: Returns the combined message and error details as a string, including all cause messages if an error is present.
